title: Three Parachutes
topic: Three black parachutes and one red school bag with the same pattern on a falling plane
voiceoverScript: Mid-flight, both engines die. The plane starts falling! The captain bursts in. Bad news. We have three parachutes, and four people. Three black packs hang by the door. Plus one red one. Same straps, same buckle. The captain grabs one. I'm the captain! I must survive! I go first! And just like that, he's gone. The mom grabs the red one. I'm a woman! Ladies get priority! And she jumps too. Two kids left. Two parachutes. Easy math. Then one kid screams. Hey! That lady took my school bag! Somewhere below, she pulls the cord. Out come pencils, a lunchbox, and math homework.
